verdict.rationale: Column is an API-first bank. Agents can read accounts programmatically (column-docs-2), query transfers across all payment types from one unified endpoint (column-docs-9), and pull transaction and summary reports in JSON (column-docs-8), all against a published OpenAPI spec and llms.txt (column-docs-10, column-probe-1, column-probe-2). Holds give a view into pending-style activity (column-docs-14), and monthly statements exist (column-docs-21), though API retrieval of statements is not explicitly documented. Missing for 10: an MCP server, explicit API access to statements and documents, a dedicated pending-transactions view beyond holds, and independent hands-on corroboration of agent read access.
